description: This file contains test cases for the ExecuteStandingInstructionsTasklet class, specifically testing whether standing instructions are considered due based on their date relative to the current date.

classes.name: ExecuteOverdueAndCurrentStandingInstructionsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behavior of ExecuteStandingInstructionsTasklet regarding due standing instructions based on date.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the thread local context for tenant and action context before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the thread local context after each test.

methods.name: testAcceptPreviousDateAsDue
methods.description: Verifies that a standing instruction with a date in the past (previous date) is considered due.

methods.name: testAcceptCurrentDateAsDue
methods.description: Verifies that a standing instruction with the current date is considered due.
